name: Turtle Conservation Society of Malaysia (TCS)
legalName: Persatuan Pemuliharaan Tuntung, Kura-Kura dan Penyu Malaysia
summary: Recovers Malaysia's depleted wild turtle populations, especially freshwater turtles and terrapins, through research, nest protection, rehabilitation and community education.
programmes: Terrapin Conservation Centre and Turtle Camps
Junior Scientist Programme and nature discovery trips
Empowerment livelihood programme for local women
impact: 1,673 river terrapin eggs collected and 1,254 hatchlings emerged in 2026; 690 juveniles released into the Kemaman River (The Star, Oct 2026)
13,224 eggs incubated and over 8,000 hatchlings released since 2012 (The Star, Oct 2026)
beneficiaries: River terrapins and other freshwater turtles in Kemaman, Terengganu; local communities and schoolchildren

organisation.founders: Dr Chan Eng Heng and Dr Chen Pelf Nyok (turtle scientists; Dr Chen remains Executive Director)
organisation.leadership: Committee 2024-2026: President Dr Maketab Mohamed; Vice President Dr Chen Pelf Nyok; Secretary Nurul 'Ain Najwa; Treasurer Hadifah Ruhaizi. Staff: Executive Director Dr Chen Pelf Nyok
